cards.question:
Convert between closed and half-open intervals

Represent the same set of integer indices using a closed interval and a half-open interval.
cards.answer:
- Closed to half-open: `[l, r] -> [l, r + 1)`
- Half-open to closed: `[l, r] -> [l, r - 1)`

Comments:

- Closed to half-open can in principle overflow with `r + 1`
- Half-open to closed is undefined if `l == r` (empty half-open interval)

Empty half-open interval detection

Determine whether `[l, r)` is empty.
cards.answer: Empty if `l == r`, undefined if `l > r`.

cards.question:
Empty closed interval detection

Determine whether `[l, r]` is empty.

Overlap of closed intervals

Determine whether `[a, b]` and `[c, d]` share at least one point
cards.answer: The intervals overlap if `a <= d && c <= b`, or equivalently if `max(a, c) <= min(b, d)`

cards.question:
Overlap of half-open intervals

Determine whether `[a, b)` and `[c, d)` share at least one point
cards.answer:
The intervals overlap if `a < d && c < b`, or equivalently
if `max(a, c) < min(b, d)`

cards.question:
Disjoint half-open intervals

Determine whether `[a, b)` and `[c, d)` are disjoint.
cards.answer: The intervals are disjoint if `(b <= c || d <= a)` (if one interval is completely before the other)

cards.question:
Union of overlapping intervals

Produce the union of overlapping...

- Closed intervals `[a, b]` and `[c, d]`.
- Half-open intervals `[a, b)` and `[c, d)`.
cards.answer:
- `[min(a, c), max(b, d)]`
- `[min(a, c), max(b, d))`

cards.question:
Intersection of overlapping intervals

Produce the intersection of overlapping...

- Closed intervals `[a, b]` and `[c, d]`.
- Half-open intervals `[a, b)` and `[c, d)`.
cards.answer:
- `[max(a, c), min(b, d)]`
- `[max(a, c), min(b, d))`

cards.question:
Interval adjacency

State the adjacency (intervals are consecutive with no overlap) condition for:

- closed intervals `[a, b]` and `[c, d]`
- half-open intervals `[a, b)` and `[c, d)`
cards.answer:
- Closed intervals: `b + 1 == c`
- Half-open intervals: `b == c`
